scripts.name: Find a free bed
scripts.description: Allocates a free bed by gender and grade.
scripts.code:
# Find a free bed for the employee of this allocation (button "Find a free bed").
# A room fits when its gender is the employee's, it has a free bed and its grade list is empty or holds the employee's category.
emp = employees.get(record["employee"])
if emp is None:
    stop("The employee is not found (or you may not see the employee).")
if record["room"]:
    stop("A room is already allocated – vacate it first.")
rooms = records.search("camp_room", {"state": "active", "gender": emp.gender, "free_beds__gt": 0}, limit=500, order="free_beds")
chosen = None
for room in rooms:
    grades = [g.strip().lower() for g in (room["grade"] or "").split(",") if g.strip()]
    if not grades or emp.category.lower() in grades:
        chosen = room
        break
if chosen is None:
    stop(f"No free bed for {emp.name} ({emp.gender}, {emp.category or 'no category'}).")
# the bed numbers already taken in that room
taken = [int(a["bed"]) for a in records.search("camp_allocation", {"room": chosen.id, "state__in": ["requested", "allocated"]}, limit=1000) if a["bed"]]
bed = 1
while bed in taken:
    bed += 1
record.update({"room": chosen.id, "bed": bed})
chosen.update({"occupied": (chosen["occupied"] or 0) + 1})
record.move("allocate", f"Room {chosen['room_no']}, bed {bed} (found by the script)")
log(f"{emp.name}: {chosen['camp']} room {chosen['room_no']} bed {bed}")
if emp.user_id:
    notify(emp, "Camp accommodation", f"Your room: {chosen['camp']} {chosen['room_no']}, bed {bed}, from {record['from_date']}.")
